project.name: penguin
project.description: A modern desktop API client for gRPC-Web, gRPC, REST, and SDK testing built with Tauri 2, React 19, and Rust. Features package management, Redis GUI, knowledge graph wiki, and MCP integration.

nodes.name: penguin-paths.ts
nodes.summary: Mirrors the Penguin desktop package layout under ~/.penguin/ so the MCP server can discover packages installed via the UI; resolves protocol directories, seeds package.json/.npmrc, and lists installed @snsoft packages.

nodes.name: penguinRoot
nodes.summary: Resolves the Penguin data root directory, preferring an existing ~/.pengvi directory and falling back to ~/.penguin.

nodes.name: protocolDir
nodes.summary: Returns the per-protocol package directory (packages/<protocol>) under the Penguin data root.

nodes.name: ensurePackageDir
nodes.summary: Creates the protocol package directory on demand, seeding a minimal package.json and copying the user's ~/.npmrc so npm installs against the private registry work.

nodes.name: listInstalledPackages
nodes.summary: Scans the protocol's node_modules/@snsoft directory and returns name/version info parsed from each installed package's package.json.

nodes.name: runners.ts
nodes.summary: Node-flavored implementations of the runner abstractions @penguin/core requires: dynamic module loading for installed @snsoft packages, npm-based install/uninstall, and a Node sidecar process runner used by the MCP server.
nodes.languageNotes: The Penguin desktop app has Tauri-backed versions of these abstractions; this file provides the plain-Node equivalents using child_process and fs directly.

nodes.name: makeLoadModule
nodes.summary: Builds a LoadPackageModule that dynamic-imports an installed @snsoft package's main entry point from the protocol's node_modules directory.

nodes.name: installPackageViaNpm
nodes.summary: Spawns npm to install an allow-listed @snsoft package spec into the protocol directory, streaming stdout/stderr and resolving with an InstallResult.

nodes.name: uninstallPackageViaNpm
nodes.summary: Spawns npm to remove an installed package from the protocol directory, capturing output and exit status.

nodes.name: nodeSidecarRunner
nodes.summary: SidecarRunner implementation that pipes a script into a spawned Node process via stdin and resolves with the collected process output.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the MCP server package: ES2022 target, bundler module resolution, strict mode, source maps, output to dist/.

nodes.name: .penguin.config.json
nodes.summary: Bundled default Penguin configuration (dot-prefixed variant) defining named environment presets with URL/TOKEN/X_ENV_TAG variables for the grpc, grpc-web, and sdk protocols.

nodes.name: penguin.config.json
nodes.summary: Bundled default penguin.config.json shipped with the app, defining per-protocol (grpc, grpc-web, sdk) environment presets such as admin/local endpoints with URL, TOKEN, and X_ENV_TAG variables.

nodes.name: ARCHITECTURE.md
nodes.summary: Bilingual architecture design document for the future Penguin Runtime, a macOS Virtualization.framework-based container runtime: design stance, process model, VM and container lifecycle, networking, storage, shared filesystem, performance/memory, security, planned Rust crate and Swift module layout, IPC design, and an M0-M8 roadmap with a decision log.

nodes.name: release.sh
nodes.summary: Interactive unified release script: bumps the version via set-version.mjs, syncs Cargo.lock, runs JS tests and typecheck, commits and pushes the version bump, then tags vX.Y.Z to trigger the CI build and GitHub release on the public shiengng12345/penguin repo.
nodes.languageNotes: Gated with interactive read prompts at each step so the operator can abort before the irreversible tag push.

nodes.name: set-version.mjs
nodes.summary: Version-bump helper that validates a semver argument and writes it into package.json, src-tauri/tauri.conf.json, and src-tauri/Cargo.toml, failing fast if any file lacks the expected key.

nodes.name: build.rs
nodes.summary: Standard Tauri build script that invokes tauri_build::build() to generate the app's build-time glue.

nodes.name: default.json
nodes.summary: Default Tauri capability granting the main and auth-popover windows core permissions plus shell open/kill, store, updater, process restart, and clipboard text write, with scoped shell command allowances.

nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Rust crate manifest for the Tauri backend (penguin_lib): Tauri 2 with the unstable multi-webview feature plus shell/store/updater/process/clipboard plugins, rusqlite, toml_edit, reqwest, tokio, and notify.
nodes.languageNotes: The tauri `unstable` feature unlocks the multi-webview API used by inline_webview to embed Vault/ArgoCD UIs; the clipboard plugin bypasses WKWebView user-gesture limits in async code paths.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README to understand Penguin — a modern desktop API client for gRPC-Web, gRPC, REST, and SDK testing built with Tauri 2 + React 19 + Rust.

tour.title: Application Entry Point
tour.description: The React application bootstraps here, mounting the root component and initializing the Tauri-based desktop shell.

tour.title: Core Package — Protocol Clients
tour.description: The @penguin/core package provides gRPC-Web and native gRPC clients, proto parsing, and service discovery — the foundation for all API interactions.

tour.title: Rust Backend Commands
tour.description: The Tauri backend (Rust) exposes commands for gRPC proxying, Redis operations, REST API, MCP, and knowledge graph — bridging the frontend to system-level capabilities.

tour.title: State Management
tour.description: Zustand store defines the application state shape and persistence layer, synced to SQLite via Tauri plugin-store.

tour.title: REST API Client
tour.description: The REST module includes request building, cURL import/export, collections, response formatting, and body field management.

tour.title: Knowledge Graph System
tour.description: The knowledge graph subsystem indexes code and notes into a queryable graph with communities, fusion, and MCP tool access.

tour.title: MCP Integration
tour.description: The Model Context Protocol package exposes knowledge graph tools for AI agents, enabling code-aware interactions.

tour.title: Redis GUI Module
tour.description: A full Redis GUI with connection management, key browser, console, pub/sub monitor, and RDM shell — all backed by Tauri Rust commands.

tour.title: Wiki & Knowledge Browser
tour.description: Visual knowledge graph explorer with 2D/3D force graphs, timeline, note editor, and context panes.

tour.title: Test Suites
tour.description: Comprehensive test coverage using Node.js native test runner, spanning knowledge graph, REST, Redis, registry, vault, and UI components.

tour.title: CI/CD & Build Configuration
tour.description: GitHub Actions workflows for build, GitHub Pages deployment, and public sync, plus project-level build configuration.
